extraction.Name: Robert Valandry
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent to his 160 acre allotment at the time he received it, but that he was advised he Indian Agency that he would have to take it, so he did
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to State Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $1000.00; deed given to Alice Wickman, of Martin, South Dakota, in exchange for paying all back taxes and clearing the mortgage
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: in April, 1919, taxes being behind, he mortgaged this allotment to the State Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $1000.00; that he could not keep the payments up on this mortgage, and, in 1921, taxes being behind since 1919, he told Alice Wickman, of Martin, South Dakota, that if she would pay up all back taxes and clear the mortgage, he would give her the deed
extraction.Occupation/Income: working in a pool hall, which is his chief income
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent, has good health; single; helps to support his parents, both of whom have poor health, having rheumatism and generally run down; deponent states this was mighty poor price for the land, but he was forced into it by the circumstances; has never received any help from the County or Government; affidavit sworn November 19, 1928
